LESSON: MY PURPOSE TALENTS AND ABILITIES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: My purpose Talents and abilities

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: My purpose Talents and abilities
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: what they have learnt, 1. Why is it important to know your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
2. apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
• Model 2: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
2. Practise: apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for My purpose Talents and abilities.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what they have learnt, 1. Why is it important to know your talents, gifts and abilities?
2. How do you nurture your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
• apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
